quests.instruction: Which clue suggests a peach is ripe?
quests.correctAnswer: A warm yellow-cream background color and a sweet smell
options: A warm yellow-cream background color and a sweet smell
A pale green background color and almost no smell
Cracked, leaking skin and a sour, fermented smell
quests.hint: Look under the blush for the base color.
quests.explanation: A yellow or cream background color under the blush and a sweet smell are good signs. A green background can mean it was picked too early.
quests.funFact: A peach softens after picking but does not get much sweeter.

quests.instruction: Which sign shows cherries are fresh?
quests.correctAnswer: Plump, shiny fruit with green stems
options: Dull, wrinkled fruit with dry brown stems
Soft fruit leaking juice
Plump, shiny fruit with green stems
quests.hint: Fresh fruit looks full and bright.
quests.explanation: Fresh cherries look plump and shiny, and their stems are still green.
quests.funFact: Cherries picked with their stems on tend to stay fresh longer.

quests.instruction: Which sign shows blueberries are fresh?
quests.correctAnswer: Firm, plump berries with a dusty-blue coat
options: Shriveled berries with a dull, wrinkled skin
Soft berries that leak sticky juice
Firm, plump berries with a dusty-blue coat
quests.hint: Fresh berries are full and firm.
quests.explanation: Fresh blueberries are plump and firm, with a pale, dusty coat called bloom.
quests.funFact: Blueberry leaves turn bright red in autumn.

quests.instruction: Which clue shows a mature coconut still holds water inside?
quests.correctAnswer: You hear it slosh when you shake it
options: You hear it slosh when you shake it
It feels very light when you lift it
It has cracks and a sour smell all over
quests.hint: Use your ears.
quests.explanation: A coconut that sloshes when shaken still has water, while a very light one may have dried out.
quests.funFact: As a coconut matures, its water slowly decreases while the white flesh gets thicker.

quests.instruction: How can you tell that a jackfruit is ripe?
quests.correctAnswer: A strong sweet smell and slightly soft skin
options: A strong sweet smell and slightly soft skin
A smell like wet paint and rock-hard skin
Bright green, shiny skin and no smell at all
quests.hint: A ripe one announces itself.
quests.explanation: Ripe jackfruit gives off a strong sweet smell, and its spiky skin yields slightly when pressed.
quests.funFact: The smell of a ripe jackfruit can be noticed from a distance.

quests.instruction: How does a papaya's skin change as it ripens?
quests.correctAnswer: From green to yellow-orange
options: From orange to dark green
From yellow to bright white
From green to yellow-orange
quests.hint: Think of the color of a ripe papaya.
quests.explanation: Papaya skin turns from green to yellow-orange as the flesh softens and sweetens.
quests.funFact: Papaya flesh can be orange, yellow or even pinkish-red, depending on the kind.

quests.instruction: Some people pull a leaf from a pineapple's crown to test ripeness. Is that a reliable test?
quests.correctAnswer: No, smell and color are better clues
options: Yes, it always works
No, smell and color are better clues
Yes, but only for small pineapples
quests.hint: Think about what you can check without damaging the fruit.
quests.explanation: The leaf test is a popular myth. A sweet smell at the base and a golden color are better clues.
quests.funFact: Some pineapples stay greenish even when they are ripe.

quests.instruction: Does green skin always mean a fruit is unripe?
quests.correctAnswer: No, limes and green apples are ripe while green
options: Yes, any fruit that is green is not yet ready to eat
No, limes and green apples are ripe while green
Yes, green fruit is always too sour to enjoy
quests.hint: Think about limes and green apples.
quests.explanation: Many fruits are ripe while green, including limes and green apples, so smell and feel are also important clues.
quests.funFact: Granny Smith apples and limes are picked and eaten green.

quests.instruction: Which fruit has wrinkled skin when it is ripe and ready to eat?
quests.correctAnswer: Passion fruit
options: Passion fruit
Apple
Peach
quests.hint: Smooth skin can mean it is not ready yet.
quests.explanation: Ripe passion fruit has dimpled, wrinkled skin, while smooth skin often means it is not ready yet.
quests.funFact: Wrinkled passion fruit often have especially fragrant pulp.

quests.instruction: A ripe avocado will not be eaten for two days. What can slow its ripening?
quests.correctAnswer: Put it in the fridge
options: Put it in the fridge
Put it in the sun
Put it in a paper bag with a banana
quests.hint: Cool temperatures slow things down.
quests.explanation: Cool temperatures slow ripening, so a ripe avocado lasts longer in the fridge.
quests.funFact: An unripe, hard avocado should stay on the counter because cold can stop it from ripening well.

quests.instruction: A packet of fruit has a "best before" date. What does it tell you?
quests.correctAnswer: When the food should be at its best quality
options: The last day the fruit is safe to eat
The day the fruit was picked from the tree
When the food should be at its best quality
quests.hint: Think about the words on the label.
quests.explanation: A best before date tells you when the food is expected to be at its best, and you should still check how it looks and smells.
quests.funFact: Fresh fruit often has no date because it is sold soon after picking.

quests.instruction: Fresh, firm cranberries do what when dropped on a hard surface?
quests.correctAnswer: They bounce
options: They flatten
They bounce
They shatter
quests.hint: Tiny air pockets are inside.
quests.explanation: Fresh cranberries are firm and have tiny air pockets inside, so they bounce.
quests.funFact: Cranberries were once sorted by how well they bounce.

quests.instruction: Why do grapes get wrinkly when they sit for too long?
quests.correctAnswer: They slowly lose water
options: They grow more skin
They slowly lose water
They fill with air
quests.hint: Think about what makes fruit plump.
quests.explanation: As grapes lose water, their skins shrink and wrinkle, a bit like raisins.
quests.funFact: Dry air makes fruit lose water faster.

quests.instruction: Why can fruit that ripens fully on the plant taste extra sweet?
quests.correctAnswer: The plant keeps feeding it sugar until picked
options: The plant keeps feeding it sugar until picked
The plant coats the skin with extra sugar
The fruit grows more seeds while it waits
quests.hint: Think about what stays connected to the plant.
quests.explanation: Fruit that stays on the plant keeps receiving sugars, so fully ripened fruit can taste sweeter.
quests.funFact: Some fruits, like strawberries and grapes, only get sweet while still on the plant.

quests.instruction: As fruit ripens it gets softer. Why?
quests.correctAnswer: The tiny walls holding the flesh together slowly break down
options: The tiny walls holding the flesh together slowly break down
Air slowly fills the spaces inside the fruit as it ripens
The skin slowly grows thicker and squeezes the flesh
quests.hint: Think about what holds the flesh together.
quests.explanation: Ripening gradually softens the tiny walls that hold the flesh together, so the fruit becomes softer.
quests.funFact: This is why very ripe fruit can turn mushy.

quests.instruction: Which strawberries are the best to pick or buy?
quests.correctAnswer: Fully red with a bright green cap
options: White near the cap and pale in the middle
Fully red with a bright green cap
Dark, wet and mushy near the cap
quests.hint: Strawberries do not ripen after picking.
quests.explanation: Strawberries do not ripen after picking, so look for berries that are red all over with a fresh green cap.
quests.funFact: A strawberry plant produces berries over several weeks.

quests.instruction: A very ripe plantain with a black skin is usually used for what?
quests.correctAnswer: Sweet dishes
options: Salty chips only
Sweet dishes
Nothing, it cannot be eaten
quests.hint: Think about what ripening does to taste.
quests.explanation: Green plantains are starchy and used in savory dishes, while very ripe, dark ones are sweeter and often used in sweet dishes.
quests.funFact: Ripe plantains are often fried until they are golden and caramelized.

quests.instruction: Which clue shows an apple is fresh and crisp?
quests.correctAnswer: Firm, shiny skin with no soft spots
options: Wrinkled skin with a few soft spots
A sharp, sour and fermented smell
Firm, shiny skin with no soft spots
quests.hint: Fresh fruit feels firm.
quests.explanation: Fresh apples feel firm with smooth, shiny skin and no soft spots.
quests.funFact: Apples float because about a quarter of an apple is air.

quests.instruction: Which sentence about fruit is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Fruit is a tasty part of a balanced diet along with other foods
options: Fruit should be the only food on your plate every day
Fruit is a tasty part of a balanced diet along with other foods
Fruit can replace all other foods because it is healthy
quests.hint: Think about a plate with many different foods.
quests.explanation: A balanced diet includes many kinds of food, and fruit is one healthy and tasty part of it.
quests.funFact: Many people try to eat fruits and vegetables of different colors every day.

quests.instruction: What does a piece of fruit usually have that candy does not?
quests.correctAnswer: Fiber and vitamins from the plant
options: Fiber and vitamins from the plant
Lots of added sugar and flavoring
Artificial colors and sweeteners
quests.hint: Think about where fruit comes from.
quests.explanation: Fruit has natural sugar along with fiber, water and vitamins, while candy is mostly added sugar.
quests.funFact: Fruit also gives you water, which candy does not.

quests.instruction: Why is it good to eat different kinds and colors of fruit?
quests.correctAnswer: Different fruits give us different good things
options: All fruits give us exactly the same things
Only red and orange fruits are really useful
Different fruits give us different good things
quests.hint: Think about a fruit bowl with many colors.
quests.explanation: Different fruits contain different vitamins, minerals and fibers, so variety is a great idea.
quests.funFact: Eating many different fruits also keeps snacks interesting.

quests.instruction: Which of these fruits is made mostly of water?
quests.correctAnswer: Watermelon
options: Avocado
Date
Watermelon
quests.hint: Think about which one feels juicy and cool.
quests.explanation: Watermelon is about 90 percent water. Dates are chewy and dry, and avocado is rich and creamy.
quests.funFact: Strawberries and oranges are watery fruits too.

quests.instruction: The sweet taste of ripe fruit comes from what?
quests.correctAnswer: Natural sugars made by the fruit
options: Sugar sprayed on by the farmer
Natural sugars made by the fruit
Salt that the roots take from soil
quests.hint: Think about what happens as fruit ripens.
quests.explanation: Ripe fruit makes its own natural sugars, which give it a sweet taste.
quests.funFact: Different fruits have different amounts of natural sugar.

quests.instruction: What do we call the part of plant foods that helps keep our tummies working well?
quests.correctAnswer: Fiber
options: Wax
Fiber
Sap
quests.hint: Apple skin has plenty of it.
quests.explanation: Fiber is the part of plant foods that our bodies cannot fully digest, and it helps keep our tummies working well.
quests.funFact: An apple eaten with its skin gives more fiber than a peeled apple.

quests.instruction: Which vitamin are oranges, strawberries and kiwi especially known for?
quests.correctAnswer: Vitamin C
options: Calcium
Iron
Vitamin C
quests.hint: It is named after a letter.
quests.explanation: Citrus fruits, strawberries and kiwi are good sources of vitamin C, which our bodies need.
quests.funFact: Vitamin C is found in many fruits and vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which mineral are bananas especially known for?
quests.correctAnswer: Potassium
options: Iron
Calcium
Potassium
quests.hint: It helps muscles and nerves work.
quests.explanation: Bananas are known for potassium, a mineral our bodies use to keep muscles and nerves working.
quests.funFact: Potatoes, beans and oranges also contain potassium.

quests.instruction: Why can watery fruits like watermelon be refreshing on a hot day?
quests.correctAnswer: They are full of water
options: They are always frozen
They are full of water
They are made of ice
quests.hint: Think about what your body needs when it is hot.
quests.explanation: Watery fruits help you take in fluids, along with drinking water.
quests.funFact: Drinking water is still the best way to stay hydrated.

quests.instruction: Which usually has more fiber?
quests.correctAnswer: A whole orange
options: A whole orange
A glass of orange juice
They have exactly the same
quests.hint: Squeezing takes something out.
quests.explanation: Squeezing removes much of the fiber, so a whole orange has more fiber than juice.
quests.funFact: Juice can be a nice treat, but whole fruit fills you up more.

quests.instruction: How are raisins different from fresh grapes?
quests.correctAnswer: Most of the water is gone, so they are smaller and sweeter
options: They contain more water, so they are bigger and juicier
They are the same as grapes but dyed a darker color
Most of the water is gone, so they are smaller and sweeter
quests.hint: Think about what drying does.
quests.explanation: Drying removes most of the water, so raisins are chewy and their natural sugar is more concentrated.
quests.funFact: Dried fruit is handy for trips because it lasts longer than fresh fruit.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a whole fruit?
quests.correctAnswer: Apple slices
options: Apple slices
Fruit gummy snacks
Fruit-flavored drink
quests.hint: Think about what is just fruit and nothing else.
quests.explanation: Apple slices are whole fruit. Gummy snacks and flavored drinks are made products and may have added sugar and little real fruit.
quests.funFact: Reading labels helps you spot how much real fruit is in a product.
